Name: iDRACNetworkIsolation
Description: Dell PowerEdge iDRAC9: moves the iDRAC to its dedicated port and removes the OS-to-iDRAC pass-through NIC (Remote NDIS, 169.254.x) from Windows, which otherwise registers unroutable addresses in DNS and breaks WinRM / the Exchange Management Shell. Run once per server with Set-iDRACNetworkIsolation.ps1 (-WhatIf first). Bump Version whenever a file of this application changes.
RunAs: Local administrator (elevated); needs racadm, installed with the server's Dell tools
